name: Gremlins
description: Aether-eating creatures released to drain the turret.

timeline.summary: The renegades release dozens of gremlins that devour the turret's aether and disable it.
timeline.quote: Torn open and drained, the turret went dark and the cannon sagged, aetherless and useless.

pages_say.description: Tenacious scavengers with an insatiable appetite for aether whose messy feeding liberates aether into the environment.
Creatures of Kaladesh that gorge on aether and wreck intricate thopters.
Aether-eating creatures released to drain the turret.
